Results.ReviewText: Such a tremendous upgrade in the flavor of my food vs my Weber propane grill. And the versatility is very nice.
Results.Title: NICE GRILL

Results.ReviewText: Works great but the the grill grates could spin around a little easier and legs more sturdy
Results.Title: Maater review

Results.ReviewText: Really enjoy having a large enough kettle to use either charcoal or real wood.  There is no need to only use chips or pellets.  I also like the fact that there are a large assortment of accessories available for the grill.
Results.Title: Enjoying

Results.ReviewText: Amazed at the versatility, from low-and-slow to high temp searing. The kettle holds temperature very well once dampers are set. Since buying the Master Touch I've been grilling far more than I ever did in the past.
Results.Title: Loving the new Master Touch.

Results.ReviewText: Great Grill love all the extra features look forward to many years of grilling
Results.Title: Great Grill

Results.ReviewText:
The upgrades on this product are amazing, if you are a novice griller. I have used all the advantages of the unit to perfection. Gives the novice so many more abilitites to CREATE, HAPPINESS of a dining experience. BRAVO, Have FUN world, it's OK.
Peace and good health to all.
Results.Title: The Happines of the GRILL

Results.ReviewText:
Bought this grill as an upgrade from a smaller 18" kettle. Overall, I'm glad I upgraded and I'd buy this again. 

My one complaint about this grill is the GBS grate because it's hard to move around due to the hole in the middle of it. Nevertheless, I've replaced the GBS grate with a standard, hinged gate and all is good.
Results.Title: Great grill!

Results.ReviewText: Another quality product from Weber, I've had several Weber products and fortunately for the consumers, their standard of quality has not decreased. Hard to find these days.
Results.Title: Great Grill

Results.ReviewText: This grill has replaced my 40 year old 22" kettle and I love it!  I especially like the built-in lid holder, the removable center piece on the grate, and the ash bucket.   All of these are big improvements.
Results.Title: 22" Spring Green Kettle

Results.ReviewText: Quality product, easy to set up, makes grilling a pleasure and priced right. Replaced a less expensive unit that rusted in 3 months even with cleaning and lubing.
Results.Title: 22" Master Grill

ClientResponses.Response: We are here to support you on your grilling journey and would like to hear more about this experience. Please lookout for an email from our Support team. Thank you!
ClientResponses.Name: Weber Grills

Results.ReviewText: It's extremely hard for me to ignite charcoal with little information,
Results.Title: Too Hard to Ignite Charcoal

Results.ReviewText: Je suis très content d'avoir acheté ce BBQ, cela fonctionne très bien et facile d'entretien. J'en suis très heureux. Merci pour votre qualité et servicxe.
Results.Title: Super

Results.ReviewText: So far so good.  I am still learning the ins and outs of grilling but I decided to step up to the Weber from my generic kettle grill.  As I said, I am a novice griller and I had never gotten grill marks until I used the Weber.  I looked forward to smoking meats and fish using the baskets for indirect heat.
Results.Title: Lives up to Reputation

Results.ReviewText: Quality build, affordable pricing,  operates extremely well! Is not my first Weber and will not be my last!
Results.Title: Excellent Grill!

Results.ReviewText: Love it so far still learning and trying new things perfecting the skills I need to make the best cooks possible
Results.Title: So far so good

Results.ReviewText: Used it once.  Performed as expected.  Wish the cover is hinged.  The thermometer should be near the top vent to indicate the correct smoking temp.
Results.Title: general review

Results.ReviewText: Je l'aime beaucoup et avec la cheminée Weber c'est facile a faire partir le feu. Je l'ai acheter pour mon fils, merci.
Results.Title: Je suis très content l va super bien.

Results.ReviewText: Bought this grill and it came with a big scrape on the edge of the lid. Weber shipped me a new lid and all is good now. Wish the metal was a heavier gauge like my 27” I’ve had for 10+ years but it will work fine.
Results.Title: Good grill and good service

Results.ReviewText: This grill has great features including the lid holder and ash catcher! The lid holder is great when you’re trying to quickly open the grill to put something in or check on your food. I love the charcoal holders as well—great for easily setting up a two heat zone grill.
Results.Title: Lid holder is best addition to old Weber styles

Results.ReviewText: Great kettle grill/smoker. Best all around, all in one on the market. The quality of the stainless steel grates is good. Thermometer works great. Cool to the touch vent handles. Charcoal catcher. Extra shelf rack included. Love it!
Results.Title: The Gold Standard of Charcoal Grills

Results.ReviewText: No need for fancy pellet grills or smokers, this kettle is a one stop do it all outdoor kitchen. Yes, it'll cook, sear, roast, grill, bake, and more. Just do your research, watch those YouTube videos and you'll be fine. The 22" is the perfect size to feeding hungry folks. And don't forget the accessories. Tailor it to your needs. Sit back, enjoy and watch your kettle get to work. My only regret is not getting one sooner.
Results.Title: The one that does it all

Results.ReviewText: Great grill. Got it for my husband as a gift and he absolutely loves it.
Results.Title: Great gift

Results.ReviewText: Weber is the best kettle and by far the best customer support.  I have 7 different types of grills and always fall back on my webber kettle.
Results.Title: All around the best

Results.ReviewText: I absolutely love my Weber Kettle Master Touch BBQ! The quality is exceptional, and the cooking performance is top-notch. The features make it incredibly versatile and easy to maintain. Whether I'm searing steaks or smoking ribs, this grill delivers exceptional results every time. I highly recommend it to everyone!
Results.Title: Loving my Kettle!

Results.ReviewText: What can I say, Weber is the best grill out there!
Results.Title: Great

Results.ReviewText: Easy to work with and fantastic results. A lot of fun. Can’t go wrong with this grill. Charcoal buckets and duel grill flaps that allow you to add more charcoal, wood chips ord chunks for some smoke flavor are great.
Results.Title: Charcoal is the best way.

Results.ReviewText: We replaced our gas grill with this earlier this month. It's much safer and the food tastes better.  The first burgers I made on it were the best I've ever grilled.
Results.Title: Excellent charcoal grill

Results.ReviewText: Love my Master Touch!  It has all the features you could ever want.
Results.Title: Ribeye Wrangler

Results.ReviewText: Easy to use,  so many aftermarket options,  relaxing afternoons grilling.   There are many reasons why Weber is the gold standard in kettles!
Results.Title: Great food from a great product

Results.ReviewText: LOVE This!t Tok abit of time to understand venting on the bottom for burning charcoal as i wasn't used to that but it works beautifully! Love the rack design. would get another one
Results.Title: Awesome grill

Results.ReviewText: This is the best charcoal grill I have ever owned. I initially got it for small cooks and the easy clean up, but once I got it home, realized it could do so much more. I have a pellet smoker, and initially started looking at charcoal grills to grill steaks, hamburgers, hot dogs, etc, but the more I researched charcoal grills, the deeper I got into capabilities. And this grill is more than capable on every level! I am going to see how smoking meat goes on this grill. I am very excited to explore the possibilities!
Results.Title: This isn't your Daddy's Charcoal Grill

Results.ReviewText: My go to Grill.  I have an offset and a pellet grill too.  But, I by far loving cooking and smoking on this classic Weber.  I resisted getting one for several years thinking they were cheap and old tech, but I was severely wrong.  My most prized grill right now.  Cannot wait to cook more of things I love on it.
Results.Title: Love my New Weber

Results.ReviewText: Nothing beats cooking on charcoal, and the master touch gives you so many options with the grates and the baskets. Can't go wrong!
Results.Title: Love it

14510601.Name: 22” Master-Touch™ Charcoal Grill
14510601.Description: Some things never go out of style—like the smoky flavor of charcoal, the sizzle of a summer cookout, and the iconic silhouette of the 22" Master-Touch™ Charcoal Grill. This grill features a handy Tuck-Away Lid Holder that gives you a convenient place to nest the lid against the side of the bowl, a hinged cooking grate that fits circular GBS accessories so you can explore more ways to cook, a built-in lid thermometer, and legs that are 2” taller than standard kettles. Like all Weber® kettles, it’s built to last with a porcelain-enameled bowl and lid that retain heat and resist rust, peeling, and scratching, and adjustable lid and bowl dampers to fine-tune the heat for perfect results. When it’s time to clean up, the One-Touch™ cleaning system makes it neat and effortless—just swipe the lever to clear ashes into the enclosed, high-capacity ash catcher. Two wheels make it easy to roll this timeless classic to the center of the action, right where it belongs. Because some grills don’t just cook food, they make memories.· Porcelain-enameled finish is scratch and rust-resistant· Room to cook for 6-8 people· Hinged, plated-steel cooking grate fits circular GBS grillware· Included Char-Rails make it easy to arrange charcoal· Lid thermometer makes it easy to see grill temperature· Adjustable lid and bowl dampers let you control temperature· Tuck-Away Lid Holder provides handy space to hang lid· 2 tool hooks included on bowl handle· One-Touch™ cleaning system sweeps ash into enclosed catcher· Easy to move on two durable, all-weather wheels.· Heat-resistant lid and bowl handles· Bottom, wire storage shelf· Durable fuel grate· 3 aluminum legs are rust-resistant and 2” taller· 10-year limited warranty
